measurements.note: Prior documented endpoints were transformed once into the already-calibrated active source cell using the recorded uniform clip factor and recomposition origin. The resulting active-source overlay was inspected directly: posterior croup to anterior shoulder, excluding neck, tail, fur and legs. This documentary conversion never scales source pixels. Factors remain 1; flexion/occlusion and +/-5px uncertainty remain visible rather than replaced with invented perfect per-frame lengths. V74 retains these source-space endpoints unchanged; the residual correction is declared separately, not baked into these measurements.
